purpose: topology-settled alpha.2 Four Swords discovery retest
expected_frontend_state: Both devices have the exact alpha.2 core selected, content stopped, normal controller profiles preserved, isolated save/state paths active, and synchronized logging ready.
human_actions: Confirm both devices are responsive and show the expected game state.
Connect netplay before entering the Four Swords cable menu.
On both devices, perform the normal save selection and Multi-Pak navigation.
Stop and report immediately if either endpoint shows a link failure.
If discovery succeeds, play briefly with input on both devices and report animation/audio quality.
success_signals: Both devices leave Linking with other systems.
Both devices enter the same shared session.
Both players' controls affect their logical players.
Animation and audio remain usable through multiple verification intervals.
No protocol, SIO, timeout, or divergence failure is logged.
failure_signals: Discovery remains unresolved at the time-box boundary.
Either device reports link failure or exits the session.
A protocol, SIO, timeout, mismatch, or divergence diagnostic appears.
